result.summary: 这篇论文研究语言模型在预训练中如何记忆知识、并在推理时提取知识，区分了“逐字记忆”与“可提取的知识” [S1.p3][S1.p4]。作者构建了合成的传记数据集 bioS 和由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，并采用预训练+指令微调以及混合训练两种设置进行验证 [S2.p2][S2.p4][S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.p4]。主要结论是：仅在传记上预训练再微调 QA 时，模型几乎无法对未见个体进行知识提取，而加入多样性、句子置换、重复全名等知识增强后提取准确率大幅提升 [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS2.p3]。作者进一步用近乎线性的 P-probing 和 Q-probing 探针表明，知识增强使属性几乎线性地编码在人物姓名 token 的隐藏状态中，从而支持微调后的知识提取 [S5.SS1.p4][S5.SS2.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要回答的核心问题是：语言模型回答“林肯的生日是什么”这类问题时，是基于训练中见过相似问题（即作弊/数据污染），还是真正学会了从维基百科等来源中提取知识 [abstract][S1.p5]。作者指出，以往研究使用互联网预训练模型，无法区分这两种可能，因此需要可控实验来研究模型在训练中如何记忆知识、在推理时如何提取知识 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。

evidence.quote: do they answer such questions based on exposure to similar questions during training (i.e., cheating), or by genuinely learning to extract knowledge from sources like Wikipedia?

leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer (traditional memorization / data contamination).
Given the challenges of conducting controlled experiments with internet data, we propose studying this question using well-controlled, synthetically generated data
How do language models memorize knowledge during training, and extract it later to answer questions or perform logical reasoning during inference?

method.text: 作者构建了可控的合成传记数据集 bioS（10 万个体，每人六句、每句对应一个属性）以及由 Llama 改写生成的近真实数据集 bioR [S2.p2][S2.p3][S2.p4]。训练设置包括：先在全部传记上预训练再用一半个体的 QA 做指令微调，以及将全部传记与一半个体的 QA 混合训练 [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.p4]。为解释知识存储位置，作者提出两种近乎线性的探针：基于位置的 P-probing 和基于查询的 Q-probing，冻结预训练模型、仅加少量可训练参数来线性预测人物属性 [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: The synthetic dataset, bioS, generates profiles for $N=100,000$ individuals.
We generate a six-sentence biographical text entry for each individual, highlighting six distinct aspects.
We examine a “close-to-real” dataset produced by Llama.
Here, we pre-train the language model from scratch on the BIO data, randomly sampling and concatenating them into 512-token sentences, separated by a standard <EOS> token.
In mixed training, we train the model from scratch on all BIO data and half of the QA data.
We propose two probing methods: position-based (P-probing) and query-based (Q-probing).
we aim for a more precise, context-free value from a pretrained model, focusing on the knowledge directly associated with a person’s name.

experiments.text: 实验在 bioS 和 bioR 两个数据集家族上进行，使用 GPT2/Llama 架构（bioS 用 124M，bioR 用 302M），并在负结果中尝试了 682M 模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。评估采用 QA 生成准确率，测试集为未参与 QA 训练的另一半个体，即分布外泛化 [S3.p1][S4.p1]。此外还进行了 P-probing 和 Q-probing 探针实验，以及针对 BERT 类双向模型 GBERT 的掩码语言建模实验 [S5.SS1.p1][S7.p2][S7.p3]。

evidence.quote: We use a 12-layer, 12-head, 768-dim GPT2 (124M) or Llama architecture for pre-training on the bioS data, but a larger 12-layer, 20-head, 1280-dim GPT2 (302M) or Llama for the bioR data
Only in Figure 2 when presenting a negative result, we tried a 12-layer 32-head 2048-dim GPT2 (682M).
The model’s generative accuracy is then tested on the QAs from the remaining individuals ( ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$) to assess its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization capability.
The model’s OOD generalization is then assessed on questions related to the other half, denoted as ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$, whose BIO/QA data were not involved in the fine-tuning.
We call this modified model GBERT.
Our pretraining task is now whole-word masked-language modeling (MLM).

findings.text: 混合训练能让模型学会提取知识，在 bioS single 上分布外准确率达 86.6%，bioR single 上为 77.7%，但模型表现出“为考试而学”的非正常学习行为 [S3.p2][S3.SS1.p2]。仅在传记上预训练再微调 QA 时，模型对未见个体的 QA 准确率几乎为零，即使模型规模远大于个体数、微调参数充分探索也如此 [S4.SS1.p2]。加入多样性、句子置换或重复全名等知识增强后，QA 微调准确率从 9.7% 提升到 96.6% [S4.SS2.p3]。探针实验表明，知识增强使属性几乎线性地编码在人物姓名 token 的隐藏状态中，Q-probing 准确率与 QA 微调准确率高度相关 [S5.SS1.p4][S5.SS2.p4]。此外，加入“名人”数据可将少数群体的 QA 准确率从 4.4% 提升到 86.8%（bioS），从 10.0% 提升到 76.3%（bioR）[S6.p4][S6.p5]。双向模型 GBERT 在知识不是独立单词时难以提取知识 [S7.p8]。

evidence.quote: the OOD generalization accuracies are $86.6\%$ when mixed-trained on bioS single and $77.7\%$ for bioR single.
the model employs an unconventional learning strategy.
the model exhibits zero-zero QA accuracy on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$ for all finetuning parameters.
This holds true even when the model size is $\sim$ 7000x larger than $N=100k$, with each individual exposed 1350 times during pretraining, and numerous finetuning parameters have been explored.
boosts the QA fine-tune accuracy (on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$) from 9.7% to 96.6%.
the P-probing accuracy for all six attributes rises to nearly 100% from the first special position, which is before all of the attributes.
The QA finetune accuracy correlates closely with Q-probing accuracy
Introducing celebrity data boosts the minority group’s QA accuracy (e.g., from 4.4% to 86.8% for the bioS data).
introducing celebrity data increases the minority’s accuracy from 10.0% to 76.3%.
Unless the knowledge is a standalone word or of independent words (like month, day, year), extracting knowledge after MLM pretraining might prove challenging, if not totally impossible.
